method: No meeting publishes attendance by job. Shares blend (a) society members: 6,916, of whom 1,603 are physicians (23%), (b) DMAT members trained up to March 2025: 18,909 = 5,443 physicians (29%), 7,934 nurses (42%), 5,532 logistics staff (29%; pharmacists, radiographers, paramedics, clerks), (c) a keyword count over 868 presenter affiliations in the JADM31 program PDFs (rough lower bounds), (d) the IRIDES report naming disaster medical staff, emergency and fire staff, and public health officials as the attendees.

roles.derivation: Between 23% of members and 29% of DMAT members who are physicians.
Nurses are 42% of DMAT members; lowered because students, government and fire staff also attend.
Part of DMAT logistics staff (29%); the program has disaster pharmacy orals, posters and a panel; 40 of 868 presenter affiliations mention pharmacy.

Student members are 950 of 6,437 members (15%) and attend free, but fewer travel; 81 of 868 presenter affiliations mention students or departments.
Eleven sponsored luncheon seminars and a company exhibition every day; 12 of 868 presenter affiliations are companies.

overseas_note: No overseas count published. JADM31 had English international sessions (Japan–Korea, EMT), so overseas guests exist but are few.
